Both control and consistency have worse binary human/model log loss than V6 on every corpus view. Consistency is also worse than control on all seven; each paired log-loss interval excludes zero. Repeated revision stages share families and are not independent samples.

On 117 human roots, strict false positives are 3 for all three detectors; loose false positives are V6 12, control 6, consistency 12. Human-only log loss is 0.167321, 0.309006, 0.448828 respectively. Nominal calibration targets are not population guarantees, and thresholds differ across artifacts.

Hosted outputs number 96 from 24 groups, all known model-origin and no human negatives. V6/control/consistency strict detections are 68/62/54; loose detections 83/72/82.
